dialogue.text: The roar of thunder over the school pierces my heart.

dialogue.speaker: Kiana
dialogue.text: Hoo~Hoo~ They're endless! I didn't expect all the zombies in the area would be drawn to the Houkai source! Can't keep this up.

dialogue.speaker: Kiana
dialogue.text: Almost out of ammo, and out of time too. Need to find the target immediately...
Rustle!

dialogue.speaker: Kiana
dialogue.text: Who's there!?

dialogue.speaker: Kiana
dialogue.text: Doesn't look like a zombie... Could it be!? Finally, I found you! Stay right there!

dialogue.speaker: Kiana
dialogue.text: Ah! This is... a student? Who would have thought there'd be someone not infected by Houkai here... Judging by the uniform, you must be an upperclassman. What's your name?

dialogue.speaker: Kiana
dialogue.text: Hey! Are you deaf? Can't you even answer something?

dialogue.speaker: Kiana
dialogue.text: Hey~ Seems you're terrified... Whatever, I can't protect you, so find a secluded corner and hide there.

dialogue.speaker: Zombie
dialogue.text: Grrooo.....

dialogue.speaker: Kiana
dialogue.text: Tsk! It's no longer safe here... If you yourself don't want to survive, then no one can save you... Farewell and don't blame me.

dialogue.speaker: Zombie
dialogue.text: Grrooo......

dialogue.speaker: Kiana
dialogue.text: Hey! What bad luck! Come with me!

dialogue.speaker: Kiana
dialogue.text: Whew~. Seems it was a bit much fighting off zombies while protecting a normal person... Hey! Are you okay?

dialogue.speaker: Kiana
dialogue.text: Tsk... I'm such an idiot. Why did I even save you? Can't even say thank you for all my trouble! Well, stay here. This old academy building should be safe for a while. I'm not going to stay and help you any longer, so you're on your own now~

dialogue.speaker: Mei
dialogue.text: ...Why did you save me?

dialogue.speaker: Kiana
dialogue.text: Huh? You finally spoke.

dialogue.speaker: Mei
dialogue.text: People like me should die and be forgotten... Perhaps my very birth was a mistake...

dialogue.speaker: Kiana
dialogue.text: Hah? What are you even talking about? Who even talks about themselves like that!

dialogue.speaker: Mei
dialogue.text: Leave me... Stop your hypocrisy. You just pretended to get close to me anyway, Raiden Mei...

dialogue.speaker: Kiana
dialogue.text: Raiden Mei? Sounds kind of familiar... I think she's a famous person at Chiba Academy... The daughter of the ME Corp president, right?

dialogue.speaker: Kiana
dialogue.text: The girl rumored to have rejected 12 guys in one day, nicknamed "Thunder Queen". And now she looks all dejected, what a rare sight~

dialogue.speaker: Mei
dialogue.text: You came to laugh at me too... Of course all people are rotten.

dialogue.speaker: Kiana
dialogue.text: Don't get me wrong, that's not why I'm here. I just want to say, instead of blaming other people, better find a way to change.

dialogue.speaker: Mei
dialogue.text: Change? That's right... That's right... It's not me who's wrong here, it's this damn world! This hypocritical world should be destroyed!

dialogue.speaker: Kiana
dialogue.text: Hey, I think that's wrong, hey! What's wrong with you!?
Crash!!!

dialogue.speaker: Kiana
dialogue.text: Agh! What the hell is up with the weather? Is this another effect of the Houkai?..
Bzzz...

dialogue.speaker: Kiana
dialogue.text: Tsk, and now the phone at a time like this... Eh! Houkai energy detected at... a distance of 0 meters?
Tzzzt!

dialogue.speaker: Kiana
dialogue.text: Huh? Why did the signal cut out? At such a critical time this phone glitches! It's right next to me! There's no one else here except this depressed rich girl!

dialogue.speaker: Mei
dialogue.text: When this hypocritical world is destroyed... Everything can return to its place... My father and everyone else will surely return to me!

dialogue.speaker: Kiana
dialogue.text: Hey! Where are you going!? Don't wander off at a time like this! Wait for me!
Crash!!

dialogue.speaker: Kiana
dialogue.text: Damn! Where did she go!? Why am I even wasting so much time on a stranger?!

dialogue.speaker: Kiana
dialogue.text: There are more and more zombies, if I go further...

dialogue.speaker: Zombie
dialogue.text: Grrraaaa...

dialogue.speaker: Mei
dialogue.text: Oh, everyone's gathered around me. As long as Dad and the others are here, I don't care about anything else~

dialogue.speaker: Kiana
dialogue.text: There she is! Damn! She's surrounded by zombies!
Bang! Bang! Bang!

dialogue.speaker: Kiana
dialogue.text: You dead bastards! Get away from that girl!!

dialogue.speaker: Mei
dialogue.text: Why are you... here again to ruin my happiness!

dialogue.speaker: Kiana
dialogue.text: What are you talking about!? I came to save you!

dialogue.speaker: Mei
dialogue.text: Get away from here! I don't need your pity!
Grrrrooo!!!

dialogue.speaker: Kiana
dialogue.text: Agh! What's with the zombies around you...

dialogue.speaker: Mei
dialogue.text: Disappear!

dialogue.speaker: Kiana
dialogue.text: Hey! Where are you going?! Damn... When I finish with these zombies, I should teach this willful young lady a lesson!

dialogue.speaker: Kiana
dialogue.text: Finally caught up to you!

dialogue.speaker: Mei
dialogue.text: Wait a little... Father, wait just a bit and Mei will become the way you want her to be!

dialogue.speaker: Kiana
dialogue.text: What happened to her? She's suddenly changed... And the reaction of the zombies around her is a bit strange... When they get close to her, they don't attack, on the contrary. They slow down and follow her.

dialogue.speaker: Corrupted Mei
dialogue.text: Aaa~ What a pleasant feeling, the whole surrounding world... No one will abandon me anymore, and everyone will find eternal happiness by my side! Ooo~ Raiden Mei, let me fulfill your wish~

dialogue.speaker: Kiana
dialogue.text: What's with your appearance!? You're not Raiden Mei! Who are you?!

dialogue.speaker: Corrupted Mei
dialogue.text: Oh~ Cute little kitten, it no longer matters who I am~ Because soon you'll join these guys and become a zombie!
BOOM!!!

dialogue.speaker: Kiana
dialogue.text: Whoa! Why the sudden lightning strike?!

dialogue.speaker: Corrupted Mei
dialogue.text: Hoho~ You're good, to be able to dodge. Seems this will be a good warm-up, let me torture you slowly~

dialogue.speaker: Kiana
dialogue.text: Just tell me who you are! Not many people can survive a Houkai eruption, except for the Kaslana family!

dialogue.speaker: Corrupted Mei
dialogue.text: Hmph... It no longer matters who I am. Raiden Mei is gone. And I exist to destroy this disgusting world!
Whack! Bang!

dialogue.speaker: Kiana
dialogue.text: The lightning energy is channeling into her... If this phenomenon is caused by Houkai, then she's currently absorbing the Houkai energy around! There are people in the world who can directly use and manipulate Houkai energy without external assistance. And only... can do that.

dialogue.speaker: Kiana
dialogue.text: Eh, seems I'm involved in a major incident... But it's too early to give up! On the other hand, maybe I'll become the savior of the world! There must be a way to stop her!

dialogue.speaker: Corrupted Mei
dialogue.text: Haha! What a great attitude. Well come on, try it!
Grrooo!

dialogue.speaker: Kiana
dialogue.text: Get away!

dialogue.speaker: Corrupted Mei
dialogue.text: Hmph! I was careless... Didn't expect a little girl like you to be able to oppose me. Seems I'll need more energy to defeat you!

dialogue.speaker: Kiana
dialogue.text: Not gonna happen!

dialogue.speaker: Corrupted Mei
dialogue.text: Agh! What do you want to do!?

dialogue.speaker: Kiana
dialogue.text: The blood of the Kaslana family has perfect resistance to Houkai energy! Since my body can withstand Houkai, then I'll cut off your supply of Houkai energy!

dialogue.speaker: Corrupted Mei
dialogue.text: Bitch! Let go! Don't touch me!

dialogue.speaker: Kiana
dialogue.text: Agh...! The surge of Houkai energy directly affecting my body... For the first time I truly feel this energy! It hurts so much!!
Please, help me... Father! Please, help me... Please, don't leave Mei alone.

dialogue.speaker: Kiana
dialogue.text: This is... A fragment of consciousness, transmitted through the Houkai energy...
Father! Why did you leave me.. Why does everyone hate me!? Why! Why! Why!!! A world like this should be destroyed!!!

dialogue.speaker: Corrupted Mei
dialogue.text: Don't look into my heart!

dialogue.speaker: Kiana
dialogue.text: Ah!

dialogue.speaker: Corrupted Mei
dialogue.text: Damn... If I had more power, no one would be able to harm me anymore!

dialogue.speaker: Kiana
dialogue.text: Stop it! You're already infected with Houkai, if you absorb this energy again, you'll lose your sanity! Then it'll be too late!

dialogue.speaker: Corrupted Mei
dialogue.text: Ha~ Don't lie to me! I saw through you long ago. You're just like them, but they envy my status and family, and you envy my abilities! I'll never forgive you... Just you wait!

dialogue.speaker: Kiana
dialogue.text: Hey! Don't run!
